@@U03796@@
Never spoil our fate with brooding grief. Our duty is being, however long or brief.

@@U03797@@
(浮士德 kisses 海伦.)

@@U03799@@
With this we have both succeeded. Now let past be past. Know yourself, my love, sprung from the highest god, for you are meant only for the pristine world. It’s not for me and these castle walls to confine you. I know a place not far where youth and peace are forever ours— 阿卡狄亚. Enticed to live upon this blesséd soil you flee now to embrace the happiest fate. Let our thrones be changed into leafy arbors, and our bliss be one of Arcadian freedom!

@@U03800@@
(The scene transforms completely.)

@@U03802@@
A series of rocky caverns with closed arbors in front of them. A shady grove extends as far as the high surrounding cliffs. 浮士德 and 海伦 are not seen. The CHORUS lies scattered about the stage asleep.

@@U03804@@
How long the girls have been asleep, I don’t know. Nor do I know if in their dreams they saw, bright and clear, what I have seen with these very eyes. And so I'll wake them.
translation:
@@U03796@@
永远不要用深沉的悲伤破坏我们的命运。我们的职责是，无论长短。

@@U03797@@
（浮士德亲吻海伦。）

@@U03799@@
至此，我们都成功了。现在就让过去的过去吧。了解你自己，我的爱人，源自至高的神，因为你只为原始世界而生。我和这些城墙不能限制你。我知道不远处有一个地方，那里永远属于我们青春与和平——阿卡狄亚。被诱惑生活在这片幸福的土地上，你现在逃离去拥抱最幸福的命运。让我们的王座变成绿树成荫的凉亭，让我们的幸福成为阿卡迪亚自由之一！

@@U03800@@
（场景完全转变。）

@@U03802@@
一系列岩石洞穴，前面有封闭的凉亭。阴凉的小树林一直延伸到周围高高的悬崖。 浮士德和海伦不见了。合唱团分散在舞台上睡着了。

@@U03804@@
我不知道女孩们睡了多久。我也不知道他们在梦中是否看到了我用这双眼睛看到的明亮而清晰的东西。所以我会叫醒他们。
